Sync writes what the last crawl found into the Postgres store
(AGENT_INDEX_PG; schema AGENT_INDEX_PG_SCHEMA, default idx): every entity
whose row changed, its labels, the chunks of files whose content changed
(read from disk again), edges and projects, in one transaction. Entities
whose card text changed are queued for agent index embed. crawl --store pg
runs it after crawling; run it alone after a crawl with the sqlite store.

--rebuild empties the schema's tables and writes everything again (card
vectors whose text is unchanged are kept); the rows are the same an
incremental sync reaches.

A schema is synced from one ledger (the index.db [ledger].path names,
else the one beside this binary): its first sync records it, and a sync
from any other is refused, since another ledger's crawl would re-key and
remove rows. --adopt-ledger moves the schema to this ledger on purpose
(a copy put at a fixed path).

Usage:
  agent index sync [flags]

Examples:
  AGENT_INDEX_PG='postgresql:///devindex?host=/run/pg' agent index sync
  agent index sync --rebuild --json

Flags:
      --adopt-ledger    Make this ledger the one the schema is synced from (a schema refuses a sync from any other ledger than its own)
      --config string   The index configuration (TOML; default: AGENT_INDEX_CONFIG, else ~/.config/gomuxai/index.toml, else built-in defaults)
  -h, --help            help for sync
      --json            Print the sync's report as JSON
      --rebuild         Empty the Postgres tables and write everything again

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
